I-334 is deferred until after the deadline (round 13, re-affirmed in round 19) because no density proxy exists at test time. Annotation density is a property of how the GT annotators chose which tracks to annotate, not of the images, so no test-time statistic identifies it. With 2 training embryos there is one bit to calibrate on, and the only way to tell which regime the private embryo is in would be to read the board, which is excluded. In exp85a SAFE_DIV_SISTER_SYMMETRY_TAU is a single global env float with no per-video hook. A density switch would need new code in the safe-division stage plus a lab gate, and tools/build_probe_kernel.py has no such patch. As a global move it is the closed TAU 0.7 rung (I-452; I-453 TAU 0.5 refuted), and tau shifts nodes (+21..+92 per bed at 0.75). On an unseen embryo the sign is a coin flip (6bba +0.00434 vs 44b6 -0.00126). Even a perfect switch gives at most ~+0.002 private.
